queries: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT ID, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_share FROM k

assumptions.assumption: The plain average of shares is the unweighted mean across all groups (all non-null IDs), computed before filtering; groups with share equal to the average are excluded (strictly above).
Each distinct non-null ID in Examination is one group, regardless of whether it exists in Patient.

responses.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT ID, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_share FROM k

assumptions.assumption: The 'plain average of the shares' is the unweighted mean of all groups' shares (over all non-null ID groups, before filtering), which equals 1/number of groups.
Groups are strictly above the average (share > average); ties are excluded.

responses.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT ID, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM k

assumptions.assumption: The 'plain average of the shares' is the unweighted mean of per-group shares across all groups (which equals 1 divided by the number of groups), not a weighted average.
The 'average amount by which their share exceeds the average share' is the mean of (share - average share) over the kept groups only.
If no groups are kept (e.g., all groups have equal counts), the query returns a single row of NULLs.
